name: render-fx-14
about: ENGINE.md section 18, designed 2026-11-24: effect 14 (ABI 13): feedback, one loop on the bus 18.30 ms round through the bus's filter's band output at 1 093 Hz, 2.24 into it, held to 0.25, standing still after 1 ms of exact zero) over the minimum beat (the bench's: bass drum, snare and the two hats), with a line lent ("delay": 1: each harness lends pi_delay_frames(rate) floats after pi_init; 14 uses the first 18.30 ms of it), for the native and WebAssembly renders to be compared. Two bars at 120 bpm. fx and key 14 go down a frame after step 1's boundary and up a frame after step 9's: heard at once from the punch, ramped in over 2 ms, the loop building on what is played, the steps that arrive (2 to 9) written into the lane, ramped out after step 9 with no tail; then the lane plays it again on steps 18 to 25. Not a trace fixture: it has no expect.
